storage: official-market-increment/0.2 default compact; original Journal schema unchanged
preflight: largest known member logical result * 2 + 64MiB (conservative on resume); not a guarantee of full-run capacity
shared_artifact_data: legacy originals referenced by exact spans
backup: Full private root including hidden marker, sidecars, wire manifests, blobs, anchors and legacy files; independent encrypted backup and isolated restore required before external scheduling
rollback: Explicitly materialize selected complete files to another Git-external location and verify SHA before using old readers; no in-place migration
